name: Student visa (subclass 500)

requirements.blocker_text: This requires an electronic Confirmation of Enrolment (eCoE) from a CRICOS-registered institution.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrolment and obtain a CoE.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires meeting the Genuine Student (GS) requirement — an assessed written statement and supporting evidence about study intentions, which replaced the older Genuine Temporary Entrant (GTE) requirement on 23 March 2024.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare a strong, specific Genuine Student statement.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires demonstrating living costs of at least $29,710 AUD/year for the primary applicant, plus tuition and return travel — plus $10,394/year for an accompanying spouse and $4,449/year per dependent child.
This requires Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for the full visa duration.

evidence_required.document: Genuine Student written statement and supporting evidence
Verifiable, genuinely-accessible funds evidence — the Department applies heightened scrutiny to illiquid assets (property, land, business valuations)

sources.title: Student visa (subclass 500) - Department of Home Affairs

notes: GENUINE STRUCTURAL FINDING confirmed during research: the financial requirement rose from AUD 24,505 to AUD 29,710/year in May 2024, explicitly pegged to '75% of the national minimum wage' — a real, confirmed formula relationship, though not modeled as a formula-type value here since Australia's own minimum wage isn't otherwise used as a national-variable in this dataset and the exact indexation mechanism/cadence wasn't independently confirmed at tier-1 precision. Multiple secondary sources still cite the pre-2024 figure (AUD 24,505) as current — a clean, confirmed stale-figure case, the same pattern as every other country in this dataset. Visa application charge increased to AUD 2,000 from 1 July 2025 (up from AUD 1,600) — another case where an older, lower fee circulates on unrefreshed secondary sites. Work rights: 48 hours/fortnight during term, unlimited during scheduled course breaks — a fortnightly rather than weekly cap, a genuinely distinctive convention not seen on any other country's student route in this dataset (all others use weekly or annual-hours caps). Genuine Student (GS) requirement replacing the older Genuine Temporary Entrant (GTE) test on 23 March 2024 is a real, confirmed, dated policy change — GTE explicitly required demonstrating intent to LEAVE Australia, while GS is framed more neutrally around genuine study intent, a meaningful philosophical shift worth surfacing since it changes what evidence actually helps an application.
